messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — prepping QBR for ArgoHealth this Fri. Need a concise cost-readiness section + onboarding heatmap. We saw a ~3x token spike last week on search flows. Anyone have an updated per-route spend forecast? cc @dave_fin @olivia_se

dave_fin: Noted the spike. They hit ~2M tokens/day on embed/search. I'll export a per-route forecast CSV and share by EOD. Quick clarifying Q: billing treats embeddings differently — which plan are they on? affects the numbers I send.

olivia_se: They are on Standard plan (embeddings billed at unit rate). Also noted they haven't enabled caching for top queries. Their client context length is set to 8192 tokens — we can recommend truncation + prefix/KV caching. Might avoid a lot of regen tokens.

maria_cs: Good call. For the QBR we need one metric that executives understand: projected monthly cost delta if we apply caching + a conservative quantization approach.

sam_prod: From Optimize heuristics: caching top-50 queries on their traffic pattern -> ~40% token reduction on search flows. Quantization to int8 could reduce inference cost ~25% on gen calls. Combined (on those flows) gives ~50–55% cost delta. I'll turn that into a single-slide visual.

dave_fin: Uploaded forecast here: https://redwood.internal/forecasts/argohealth-march.csv. FYI budget-alert fired 3x last week for this account. Recommend proposing either a small credit buffer or soft throttles during onboarding ramp.

olivia_se: Customer feedback: worried quantization hurts accuracy. Proposal: do a canary A/B — quantized model on 10% traffic + automated eval on a held prompt set, capture human-in-the-loop flags. We'll need to surface the evaluation thresholds in the playbook.

maria_cs: Action items before Thurs 10am PT (QBR dry-run): 1) @dave_fin — send consolidated spend CSV to docs + customer. 2) @olivia_se — propose caching + canary runbook (include SDK upgrade note). 3) @sam_prod — 1-slide impact (savings + risk). 4) I'll run onboarding heatmap and flag riskiest steps for enablement. Any blockers?

triage-bot: Alert: budget_alert triggered for argohealth at 5312345600, occurrences=3

dave_fin: No blockers, CSV sent and shared in the doc. Also added a column with projected post-mitigation spend (rough).

olivia_se: Drafting the canary playbook now. One detail: their SDK is on 0.9.1 which doesn't expose KV cache flags — will include an upgrade ask & sample snippet to enable cache. Example snippet I'm adding:

```
# enable prefix KV caching (pseudo)
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=... , sdk_version="0.10.2")
client.config.cache.prefix_kv = True
```

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll capture customer concerns in the call Wed 2pm PT. Please drop final artifacts in the shared QBR doc: https://redwood.docs/qbr/5312345678 — I'll assemble slides and send invite for dry-run.

sam_prod: :thumbsup: slide uploaded to the doc, will tidy up numbers by 11am PDT tomorrow.

maria_cs: Thanks team — this will make the QBR much cleaner. I'll post a summary after the dry-run.
